🚸  Improve tracebacks by adding endpoint metadata

Today, when validation errors occur, error messages don't indicate what endpoint caused the problem, which can make debugging difficult. 

This PR adds endpoint context metadata to validation error messages to show the filepath (clickable in IDEs!) and line number, function name and HTTP method and route where applicable.
